thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 Pager — runtime-engine crashloops in us-west-2-prod (app-serving pool). 20+ containers restarted in the last 10m, elevated 5xx rate for /v1/generate. Pager: #oncall-ml -> marta g.

marta g: seeing it, joining. can someone drop initial impact?

kevin h: from logs, nodes in pool are OOM/killing processes with SIGSEGV in runtime binary. Crashloop backoff observed. Example from pod runtime-serve-7f9d: ``
[2026-03-15T14:03:12Z] runtime[pid=1]: segfault at 0 ip 00007f3a1c2b8b2e sp 00007ffd6a3c3c20 error 4 in runtime_engine.so[7f3a1c1f0000+9a000]
``

jen s: customer impact: several customers using low-latency dedicated endpoints are seeing errors and retries. ETA to customers unknown, spike in latency graphs on console.

marta g: ok. initial mitigation plan: 1) cordon affected nodes 2) scale up non-affected pool to absorb traffic 3) revert runtime image for canary model backend to previous known-good 4) collect core dumps and call eng-runtime.

raj p: on it — cordoning node node-usw2-ml-12 and draining pods now.

ops-bot: drain started on node-usw2-ml-12, pods evicted: 16.

lina o: I'm spinning up 3 extra instances in the warm pool (us-west-2) to reroute traffic. suggest removing model-specific TRT kernels until we have a fix.

kevin h: note: segfault appears inside custom GPU kernels after a recent runtime build (tag: rtd-20260314-9f2). I can push rollback to rtd-20260310-6b1 which didn't have the crash signature.

marta g: proceed with rollback for canary first, then if stable, roll to prod. jen, notify affected customers via status page and support queue.

jen s: writing status page now — "Degraded performance for inference endpoints in us-west-2; we are mitigating by rolling back to previous runtime build. No data loss expected." pinging support to throttle retries for impacted tenants.

sam r: attaching recent dmesg and container logs for core collection: ``
Mar 15 14:02:59 kernel: [123456.789] NVRM: GPU at 0000:3b:00.0: Xid (PCI:0000:3b:00): 31, Ch 00000004, ctx 00000000, Reason: DRM scheduling
Mar 15 14:03:12 runtime: segfault ip=0x7f3a1c2b8b2e
``

marta g: eng-runtime, @kevin h and @raj p — can you confirm rollback plan and ETA? Also, what is the likelihood this is data-dependent vs binary bug?

kevin h: high confidence binary/regression. The crash correlates exactly with the build that introduced fused-kernel for attention combiners. Reverting removes those new kernels. ETA for canary rollback: ~8 minutes.

raj p: initiating deployment rollback for runtime image on canary service runtime-canary/us-west-2. kubectl set image ... now.

ops-bot: deployment runtime-canary updated. Old replicas terminating, new replicas pulling image rtd-20260310-6b1.

marta g: monitoring logs for segfaults post-rollback. if clear for 15m, we can stage roll to remaining pools. keep the cordoned node isolated for forensic.

jen s: support DM: three customers reported errors (acct ids: acct-42, acct-77, acct-238) — TTR asked for ETA. I'll update with rollback progress.

kevin h: quick snippet of the backtrace from core dump (sanitized): ```
#0  0x00007f3a1c2b8b2e in fused_attention_forward at fused_kernels.cu:124
#1  0x00007f3a1c30a0b2 in forward_step at runtime_engine.cc:442
#2  0x000055aaab12c3d4 in serve_request at server.cc:198
```

lina o: Canary pods are coming up on old image, health checks passing. No segfaults in last 3 mins on canary.

incident-bot: Automation check — 90% of canary replicas are Ready; no SIGSEGV in last 5m.

marta g: good. start rolling to remaining pools but do it throttled: 2 pods at a time with 5m pause. raj, coordinate.

raj p: rolling to pool app-serving-usw2: started batch 1/6.

ops-bot: autoscaler: warm pool absorbing 30% of traffic, no upstream errors reported for new replicas.

kevin h: while rolling, I'm preparing a patch to disable fused attention by feature flag as a safer hotfix in case rollback isn't sufficient. Also collecting full core + symbolized backtraces to send to kernel team.

marta g: noted. jen — continue customer comms: "We have rolled back the runtime to a previous build; traffic is being migrated and degraded errors should decline in the next 10-20m. We'll provide a postmortem with root cause and fix plan."

jen s: posted initial update and created support ticket batch for affected accounts.

sam r: additional observation — one node showed intermittent NVLINK errors before segfaults; possible GPU driver interaction. logs: ``
E 14:01:43 cudart: cudaErrorUnknown: unspecified launch failure
``

kevin h: interesting — we should still treat this as runtime regression but add drivers to the hypothesis matrix. I'll coordinate with eng-infra to check recent driver rollouts.

lina o: roll completed for batch 1; health stable. continuing.

incident-bot: Rolling update progress: 3/6 batches complete. Error rate on /v1/generate down from 12% -> 1.3%. Latency back to baseline for most routes.

marta g: great. keep a close watch for any reoccurrence. ask eng-runtime to keep the feature-flag patch ready.

kevin h: uploaded core dumps and symbolized output to the internal bucket: gs://redwood-debug/cores/1768012345/. Added a minimal repro harness that triggers fused_attention code path for CI.

raj p: all batches complete. cordoned node still isolated for root-cause. we can uncordon after forensic snapshot (taking image now).

ops-bot: node snapshot complete for node-usw2-ml-12. cordon remains.

marta g: incident update for execs: brief summary: regression in runtime build rtd-20260314-9f2 caused segfaults in fused attention kernel resulting in container crashloops and elevated error rates for dedicated inference in us-west-2. Mitigation: rolled back runtime to rtd-20260310-6b1 across pools; no customer data loss; affected customers notified; monitoring shows error rate back to baseline.

jen s: sent exec update and updated status page: "Mitigated — rollback complete; monitoring. Postmortem in progress."

kevin h: action items for postmortem: 1) reproduce and fix fused kernel bug 2) add CI fuzzing for kernel edge cases 3) add automated canary gating for builds that touch kernels 4) add better live metrics for GPU/driver interactions.

marta g: assigning owners: kevin -> kernel patch and CI, raj -> node forensic + driver checks, lina -> rollout automation improvement, jen -> customer comms & postmortem writeup.

sam r: follow-up: queue created for infra to validate GPU driver version matrix.

lina o: uncordoning node-usw2-ml-12 now (after snapshot) — leaving cordon until driver validation completes.

ops-bot: node-usw2-ml-12 uncordon request acknowledged; currently marked maintenance.

marta g: closing active pager — monitoring in watch mode for 4 hours. please post any anomalies here. handoff to follow-up team for root cause. thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :heart:  

incident-bot: Incident closed (SEV-2 -> mitigated). Duration: ~53m. Follow-up: eng-runtime postmortem required within 72h.

kevin h: adding note — we should consider adding a non-destructive fail-safe that disables fused kernels if any GPU Xid errors detected at runtime.

jen s: I'll draft customer-facing postmortem once eng-runtime provides root cause language.

marta g: ACK. handoff to oncall follow-up: raj (lead), kevin (engineer), jen (comm), lina (ops).

sam r: leaving final logs and attachments in the thread bucket.

marta g: thanks — good job team.
